clusters.name: Transfer Order Receipt Notifications
clusters.reason: Push notification support in the receiving application to alert store users of incoming inventory transfers.

clusters.name: Mis-shipped Item Management
clusters.reason: Tracking and processing items received that were not part of the original transfer shipment, including synchronization to external ERP systems.

clusters.name: Proof of Delivery
clusters.reason: Security features for customer pickups including identity verification and pickup confirmation workflows.

clusters.name: Ship to Store Fulfillment
clusters.reason: End-to-end enhancements for orders shipped from warehouses to retail stores for customer pickup, including carrier filtering and status tracking.

clusters.name: Inventory Cycle Count
clusters.reason: Comprehensive updates to inventory counting workflows, including local data management, product hydration, and variance review processes.

clusters.name: Agent Instruction Execution
clusters.reason: Implementation of an agent-based model for devices to receive and execute instructions from the server.

clusters.name: Shopify Data Integration
clusters.reason: Synchronization of customer profiles, gift card data, order tags, and transaction history between Shopify and the OMS.

clusters.name: Shopify Order Reconciliation
clusters.reason: Service to identify and report discrepancies in order statuses and quantities between Shopify and the internal system.

clusters.name: NetSuite Data Synchronization
clusters.reason: Automated feeds for inventory resets, transfer order movements, and shipment reconciliations with NetSuite.

clusters.name: Product Cost Calculation
clusters.reason: Accuracy improvements for Weighted Average Cost (WAC) calculations across receiving and return scenarios.

clusters.name: Transfer Order Lifecycle
clusters.reason: Enhancements to transfer order approval logic, item-level receiving, and fulfillment reconciliation.

clusters.name: User Permission Management
clusters.reason: Implementation of fine-grained access control based on user roles, facilities, and security groups.

clusters.name: Order Payment Capture
clusters.reason: Automated services to manage payment capture tags based on order item fulfillment status.

clusters.name: Kit Product Fulfillment
clusters.reason: Logic updates to ensure inventory deductions and shipment creation occur correctly for kit component items.

clusters.name: Application Authentication Flow
clusters.reason: Authentication logic for users logging into Shopify embedded applications via the App Bridge.

clusters.name: Order Return Management
clusters.reason: Management of external return identifications and exchange credit logic within the return processing workflow.

clusters.name: User Account Security
clusters.reason: Security features including blocked account messaging for failed logins and required password changes.

clusters.name: Order Picker Management
clusters.reason: Tools for assigning, indexing, and restricting the modification of pickers on completed orders.

clusters.name: Picklist Customer Identification
clusters.reason: Inclusion of customer names on pickup picklists to facilitate faster order verification.

clusters.name: Inventory Availability API
clusters.reason: New API endpoint for bulk retrieval of product online Available-to-Promise (ATP) quantities.

clusters.name: Customer Communication
clusters.reason: Support for automated order cancellation and shipping update emails for the routing application.
